works.title: Old Greek Stories (selected chapters)
works.creator: James Baldwin (1841-1925, the educator and textbook author, not the twentieth-century novelist)
works.use: Source for the mythological allusions the Grade 4 vocabulary standard requires. Chapters that carry high-frequency allusions include The Story of Prometheus (Promethean, Pandora's box), The Wonderful Weaver (Arachne), The Quest of Medusa's Head (Medusa, a Gorgon stare), and The Wonderful Artisan (Daedalus, flying too close to the sun). The collection contains no Hercules chapter; facilitators wanting Herculean specifically should source it separately.
